# anthropic_invites (Data Source)

Lists organization invitations. Works with any admin or enterprise credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_invites" "pending" {
  statuses = ["pending"]
}

output "pending_invite_emails" {
  value = data.anthropic_invites.pending.invites[*].email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Filter by invited email address.
- `roles` (List of String) Filter by organization roles (any match).
- `statuses` (List of String) Filter by status (`pending`, `accepted`, `expired`). Defaults to all.

### Read-Only

- `invites` (Attributes List) Invitations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `accepted_at` (String) Timestamp the invite was accepted; null until then.
- `email` (String) Invited email address.
- `expires_at` (String) Timestamp the invite expires.
- `id` (String) Invite id.
- `invited_at` (String) Timestamp the invite was sent.
- `rbac_group_ids` (List of String) Claude Enterprise RBAC group ids assigned on acceptance.
- `role` (String) Organization role granted on acceptance.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `accepted`, `expired` or `deleted`.
